In ways of dividing a donation of 1 hundred-million won, weigh up every condition that conflicts, choose the most suitable compromise, and explain why.
l-m-e4-b02-08.material: Hlukanisa wonke umnikelo ongu-100,000,000 won phakathi kwezikole ezintathu u-A, B no-C. Izimo: isikole ngasinye sithola okungenani u-20,000,000 won, u-A uthola ngaphezu kuka-B, futhi amanani ezikole ezintathu kufanele ehluke wonke. Divide the whole donation of 1 hundred-million won among three schools, A, B, and C. Conditions: each school gets at least 2 ten-million won, A gets more than B, and the amounts for the three schools must all be different.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela yokuhlukanisa ehlangabezana nazo zonke izimo?
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.a: U-A 30,000,000, u-B 40,000,000, u-C 30,000,000 A 3 ten-million, B 4 ten-million, C 3 ten-million

l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.b: U-A 50,000,000, u-B 30,000,000, u-C 20,000,000 A 5 ten-million, B 3 ten-million, C 2 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.c: U-A 40,000,000, u-B 30,000,000, u-C 30,000,000 A 4 ten-million, B 3 ten-million, C 3 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.c: U-B no-C bayalingana, ngakho amanani awahlukile wonke.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.o.d: U-A 60,000,000, u-B 30,000,000, u-C 10,000,000 A 6 ten-million, B 3 ten-million, C 1 ten-million
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.r.d: U-C uthola ngaphansi kuka-20,000,000 won. C gets less than 2 ten-million won.
l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s1.explain: Okuwukuphela kwendlela isamba esingu-100,000,000, zonke zithola okungenani u-20,000,000, u-A udlula u-B, futhi zonke zehlukile, ngu-50,000,000, 30,000,000, 20,000,000. l-m-e4-b02-08.s.s2.model.1: Ezinye izinhlelo zinamanani agqagqanayo, zifaka u-10,000,000 won, noma u-A ungaphansi kuka-B; ngakho lolu hlelo yilona oluhlangabezana nazo zonke izimo. The other plans have overlapping amounts, include 1 ten-million won, or have A less than B, so this plan is the one that follows all the conditions.
